label: prf:pion-half-figure-eight
title: Proof of pion half figure eight
html:
Proof. Both \mathfrak{M}_+ and \sigma_1\sigma_2^{-1} have determinant +1 on V_{(2,1)} (even number of Hecke generators, each with \det = -1; the product of an even number of (-1) factors is +1). Both have real trace on V_{(2,1)}:

  \chi^{(2,1)}(\mathfrak{M}_+) = -(h^2 + 1),
  \qquad
  \chi^{(2,1)}(\sigma_1\sigma_2^{-1}) = -(h^2 + 1).

Since both are 2 \times 2 matrices with \det = 1 and identical trace, they have the same characteristic polynomial:

  \lambda^2 + (h^2 + 1)\lambda + 1 = 0.

The eigenvalues are therefore identical: \lambda = \tfrac{-(h^2+1) \pm \sqrt{(h^2+1)^2 - 4}}{2}, giving complex conjugates on the unit circle with the same phase \theta = \arccos\bigl(-(h^2+1)/2\bigr). \square
heading: Proof
